verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online filing and search services (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro, DPMAregister) that handle user-submitted data, so a no-AI-training privacy guarantee is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or statement about whether that data is used to train AI models. The robots.txt probe only shows that crawlers are blocked on the register host, which is an adjacent control and not a user-facing training opt-out.
